subject: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@novamed.com>, Novamed Legal <legal@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination

Clara / Novamed legal team,

Attached is our proposed redline for the Data Processing Addendum (see redline_dpa_jonas_v1.docx). High level callouts:  
- Key rotation / KMS: we added an optional exhibit for a dedicated HSM-based BYOK path (customer-supplied keys hosted in an HSM under a separate configuration). If Novamed wants co-control we will need a different operational SLA and a pricing surcharge.
- Cross-border fallback: suggested language to default to SCCs + transfer impact addendum if BCRs are not preferred; this is an optional clause for EU-to-US fallbacks only.
- Evidence: we can provide a short technical attestation and KMS key-rotation runbook as exhibits.

Can you confirm whether Novamed requires co-control (dual-control) or would accept provider-managed keys with the BYOK option? Also need to know whether the external counsel (Kristen) will accept SCC-based fallback or requires BCRs.

If co-control, we need procurement pricing ASAP — looping in Ben and Laura for cost and legal review. My ask: Novamed to confirm preference by EOD Wednesday 7/04 so we can lock the order form and DocuSign timeline.

Attachments: redline_dpa_jonas_v1.docx (redline)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 510-555-0112
From: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@novamed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Legal <legal@novamed.com>, Kristen Smith <kristen.smith@smithpartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T17:08:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination

Jonas — thanks for the redline. Quick clarifications from our side:  
- Novamed preference is provider-managed keys by default, but we require the option for BYOK with an HSM when PHI or high-risk datasets are in scope. "Co-control" (dual-control signing) is a hard requirement only for a subset of workloads.
- On SCCs vs BCRs: our privacy team will accept SCCs for this engagement as long as the transfer impact addendum documents the mitigations and there is an audit/attestation schedule. We would prefer not to move to BCRs unless there is a strategic need.

I've attached our KMS requirements matrix (Novamed_KMS_requirements.pdf) — it lists the technical expectations for key rotation windows, escrow, and incident notification timing.

Can Redwood confirm whether the proposed exhibit supports: 1) a provider-managed default with logging and rotation; and 2) an optional BYOK+HSM premium offering that supports dual-control for specific datasets?

Regards,
Clara Hughes
VP, IT Security — Novamed
clara.hughes@novamed.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination

Thanks Clara — we can support both paths: provider-managed as the default, plus an opt-in BYOK hosted in a dedicated HSM configuration. Notes from engineering & ops:  
- BYOK+HSM requires separate provisioning, KMS tenancy separation, and an Ops runbook; we estimate a non-recurring setup fee + a monthly surcharge.
- Evidence: we can produce a technical attestation and the key rotation runbook as an exhibit. SLA implications are the main ask (we'd need a 99.9% availability SLA for the dedicated KMS config).

Ben — can you draft a short pricing sheet for the BYOK+HSM option (setup fee, monthly surcharge, and per-GB throughput delta)? We need numbers to include in the order form and to surface an exec approval if the surcharge pushes ARR impact over threshold.

Jonas — for legal, I think we can keep SCC fallback language as proposed; engineering will deliver the attestation on a quarterly cadence.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Contracts & Compliance — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination

Laura — drafting numbers now. Preliminary estimate to share with Novamed:  
- One-time provisioning/setup: $18,000
- Monthly surcharge (dedicated HSM tenancy): $4,500/month
- Per-token/throughput delta: +12% on our standard Gen price for BYOK paths when HSM mode enabled.

I will attach a simple pricing sheet and update HubSpot deal RDW-7892 with the optional line item. If Novamed accepts provider-managed default and only elects BYOK for the PHI subset, the ARR impact looks manageable and we can proceed without exec credit. If they choose full-account BYOK, we need an approval path (sales > finance > CRO).

Attachment: pricing-sheet-dedicated-hsm.xlsx

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@novamed.com>, Novamed Legal <legal@novamed.com>, Kristen Smith <kristen.smith@smithpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Key rotation and EU data paths — legal coordination

Thanks all — helpful run-through. Summary / next steps:  
1) Novamed to confirm BYOK scope (PHI-subset vs account-wide) by EOD 2028-07-06.
2) Ben to finalize pricing sheet and add optional line item to HubSpot (RDW-7892).
3) Laura & I will incorporate the attestation exhibit and the SCC fallback wording into the final DPA redline once scope is confirmed.
4) If Novamed chooses account-wide BYOK we will need an internal approval (Ben to trigger CRO/Finance).

I'll prep the DocuSign envelope and the order form draft; include the pricing optional line as a checkbox to choose the BYOK+HSM offering. DocuSign template link below — please review before I send: https://app.docusign.com/templates/abc123

If there are any open legal items Kristen needs to escalate on Novamed's side, flag them here and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Jonas
